name: OpenVibe.Shoes

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the PostgreSQL database, Valkey, Network's JWKS and the OAuth client are what /api/ready checks)

drains: HTTP server closed and in-flight requests drained
JWKS refresher stopped, then the job timers cleared
telemetry flushed and its retention timer stopped
PostgreSQL pool closed, then the Events subscriptions stopped

resumes.what: the offers and drops jobs make their first pass shortly after boot; each run is whole and idempotent with a receipt in shoe_job_runs, so a stop mid-run leaves the next one to finish
the account export and deletion subscriptions at OpenVibe.Events are renewed at boot; a delivery missed while stopped is redelivered and applied once (account_data_events keeps it idempotent)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates Shoes' own tables (models, offers, snapshots, drops, watches, job runs) plus the SDK's; an earlier release reads none of them

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site and the API

notes: Port 5180, unit openvibe-shoes.service, PostgreSQL database ov_shoes, served at open.shoes. The Shoes room (plan 5.6): shoe offers classified from OpenVibe.Deals' public API, one page per model with every store's price, daily snapshots and a stale flag; official drops with their sources; price-at-size and pasted-link watches through OpenVibe.Watch (off without its token) and drop reminders onto OpenVibe.Today with the person's own token. No affiliate links, no Marketplace scraping, no raffle automation. OAuth client `shoes`; answers account export and deletion (ADR-033) and subscribes to those Events topics.

site.name: Shoes
site.tagline: Every shoe, every market, the right price
site.what: Shoe offers from OpenVibe.Deals, one page per model with every store, price history and the time each price was checked, a cited drops calendar, and price alerts through OpenVibe.Watch. No affiliate links, no raffle bots.
